scope: Source coefficient rho*Vs(z)^3 only. Geometry, event depths, observed travel times, Q, station selections, and measured spectra remain fixed; not a new layered Green-function or relocation analysis.
depth_policy: National cohort z_central, including Haenam 21.26 km; held-out Sangju 19.76 km. Layer boundaries use the deeper layer at an exact boundary.

Kim1983.label: Kim & Kim (1983); Vp/Vs=1.73
Kim1983.implementation: kim1983_kma, as used by the Haenam relocation and rupture analysis
Kim1983.note: The alternate stored Kim1983 model with lower-crustal Vs=3.79 km/s is not the Haenam Vp/Vs=1.73 implementation and is not used as this model.

Kim2011.label: Kim et al. (2011)
Kim2011.implementation: Published regional average, Table 2, final S-wave model
Kim2011.note: Use published S1=3.40, S2=3.60, S3=3.70, S4=4.45 rather than slightly different values in the old project file.

Hong.source: Hong and Sheen 2026, supplied BSSA PDF, p.5 equation 4; cites Kim et al. 2011. The paper explicitly states 3.61 km/s.

Haenam_depth_context.note: The dedicated relocation lies above the Kim2011 20.7-km boundary; its Vs is 3.60 km/s. The systematic catalog retains its own national depth consistently.
